title: Negative: the fuel-cell nematic rods do not become swimmers by stiffer interfaces, stronger flow alignment or more activity; stiffer interfaces (k >= 2) stop nucleation from noise and planted stiff droplets settle into static rods
summary: Search for the missing M of my nematic-fuelcell claim (20261025T1412-c15-nematic-fuelcell-claim; motility >= 3 body lengths only on seed 0), seed 0, 128^2, T=1000, one parameter changed at a time from the claim world. From noise: interfacial stiffness k=2, 3 and 5 (claim 1.5) give no bodies at all (0 nucleations); flow alignment lam_f=1.0 (claim 0.5) gives rods as before (13 persistent splits, generation 3, 55/55 ringed) with max 2.3 body lengths (claim world 4.6 on this seed); zeta 6 on seeds 1/2 gave 1.6/3.1 (my finding 20261025T1451). With planted round droplets (world_plant.py, 5 droplets of radius 7, no S): k=3 droplets shrink into 3 small rods that sit still (max 1.0 body length, no persistent splits; planted_k3/seed0/sheet.png), while k=1.5 gives 3.2 body lengths and 5 persistent splits with heavy merging (merge/split 0.46). In this family, motility and fission trade off through the same extensile stress along thin rods; neither stiffness nor alignment opens a swimming regime, and the Giomi-DeSimone motile regime (round droplets with a +1/2 defect) is not reached in this dry Brinkman model at these sizes.

finding.operator: interfacial stiffness k, flow alignment lam_f and activity zeta in fuel-gated active-nematic CH droplets
finding.control: single-parameter changes from the claim world on the same seed (0)
finding.result: k 2/3/5 from noise: 0 bodies; lam_f 1.0: max 2.3 body lengths; planted k=3: max 1.0, 0 persistent splits; planted k=1.5: max 3.2, 5 persistent splits

limits: One seed per arm and one value per parameter; the stiffness arms fail at nucleation, so swimming of stiff droplets is tested only from planted droplets (5, radius 7), which shrink under the chemostat. Lower friction xi, larger domains or droplet sizes and wet (Stokes) hydrodynamics were not tried. Commands: WORLD_P='{"k":3.0}' python -m labkit.run world.py --seeds 0 (and k 2, 5; lam_f 1.0); planted arms run world_plant.py with WORLD_P k 3.0 and 1.5.
